_note: Measurements taken from the trained Track B classifier immediately before it was removed from the codebase. The model artefact itself was never committed (core/evaluator/models/*.joblib is gitignored), so these figures cannot be recomputed from this repository - they are the record. Reproduction instructions are in docs/track-b-rejection.md. This file is the single source for these numbers; the dissertation and the viva deck both read from it rather than restating them.

provenance.note: The saved model predates the correction of the reference-answer data leak, so it is the output of the defective pipeline. No training metrics file was ever produced, so held-out performance was never recorded.

behavioural_probe.reference_answer: Machine learning is a field of artificial intelligence where models learn patterns from data to make predictions without being explicitly programmed with rules.
